Name: Oiled Hinges - Remove squeaks
Author: CasketPizza
Description:
[size=6][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Requires CUSTOM MUSIC mod by Platonymous[/url][/size]

I got so sick of those mini sale boxes making [color=#ea9999][size=5][b][i]baby [/i][/b][/size][/color]noises every time I walked past so this is the fix.
Removes the squeak from chests and doors.

Extract into mods folder (along with [color=#e69138][b]SMAPI[/b] [/color]and [color=#e69138][b]CUSTOM MUSIC [/b][/color]mods)

[i]Replaced sound IDs:[/i]
[list]
[*]openChest
[*]openBox
[*]doorCreak
[*]doorCreakReverse
[/list]
